title: Our approach
positioning: The enterprise seeks to position itself in a space that connects individual, relational and collective well-being.
premise: This makes it possible to move from a view in which well-being is understood exclusively as each person's responsibility to a perspective that also asks:
questions: How do its members relate to one another?
What emotions circulate within an organization or community?
What factors strengthen or erode its sense of belonging, trust, cohesion and well-being?
closing: This perspective makes it possible to design interventions that are not limited to working with isolated individuals, but that also consider the social environments that shape their experiences and behaviors.
impactIntro: The enterprise seeks to generate impact at different levels:

impactLevels.title: Individual
impactLevels.text: people with more resources to understand themselves, relate to others and face challenges.

impactLevels.title: Relational
impactLevels.text: healthier bonds and stronger capacities for communication and coexistence.

impactLevels.title: Group
impactLevels.text: teams and groups with higher levels of cohesion, trust, participation and sense of belonging.

impactLevels.title: Organizational
impactLevels.text: institutions able to make well-being part of their culture and management.

impactLevels.title: Community
impactLevels.text: communities with greater capacity to identify their needs, strengthen their bonds and build collective responses.

synthesis: In short, CONFLUYE aims to become a specialized platform for designing and developing experiences, services and solutions for human and collective well-being, bringing together scientific knowledge, participatory methodologies and social intervention strategies to help people and groups build healthier relationships, environments and communities.
